decisions.title: The workflow owns the lookup capability
decisions.decision: Model VIN and glass lookup as a step within an auto-glass service request rather than as the top-level product.
decisions.reason: Quoting, scheduling, fulfillment, invoicing, and payment can be added without rebuilding the product boundary.

decisions.title: Use interchangeable lookup providers
decisions.decision: Place mock, Playwright, and future API integrations behind one lookup-service contract.
decisions.reason: The client experience and Express routes should not change when the integration mechanism changes.

decisions.title: Validate the static client journey first
decisions.decision: Use GitHub Pages and mock JSON for the first client demo before implementing the backend.
decisions.reason: The client approved the workflow, reducing product risk before integration investment.

decisions.title: Track delivery as structured data
decisions.decision: Use project/board.json as the Kanban source of truth and render it in a read-only project board.
decisions.reason: Humans and specialized agents can update the same auditable project state.
